title: Memory architecture
summary: Memory architecture determines what an agent retains and how it retrieves that information later.
overview: Thread state supports continuity within a task, while durable memory can span sessions. Storage structure and update timing affect retrieval quality and freshness.
why: Persisting a mistaken inference can make future runs consistently wrong.
example: An assistant stores an approved repository convention with its source and revision, while keeping temporary debugging notes in task state.
judgment: Decide who can write memory, its scope and retention, and how corrections replace stale entries.
next: How will a corrected team convention invalidate earlier memories across active sessions?
